arxiv-2104-14650.title: Exact fluctuating hydrodynamics of active lattice gases – Typical fluctuations
arxiv-2104-14650.creator: Tal Agranov, Sunghan Ro, Yariv Kafri, Vivien Lecomte
arxiv-2104-14650.description: Abstract We extend recent results on the exact hydrodynamics of a system of diffusive active particles displaying a motility-induced phase separation to account for typical fluctuations of the dynamical fields. By calculating correlation functions exactly in the homogeneous phase, we find that two macroscopic length scales develop in the system.

arxiv-2303-02762.title: Reverse Engineering Word-Level Models from Look-Up Table Netlists
arxiv-2303-02762.creator: Ram Venkat Narayanan, Aparajithan Nathamuni Venkatesan, Kishore Pula, Sundarakumar Muthukumaran and Ranga Vemuri
arxiv-2303-02762.description: Abstract Reverse engineering of FPGA designs from bitstreams to RTL models aids in understanding the high level functionality of the design and for validating and reconstructing legacy designs. Fast carry-chains are commonly used in synthesis of operators in FPGA designs. We propose a method to detect word-level structures by analyzing these carry-chains in LUT (Look-Up Table) level netlists.

arxiv-2311-05511.title: Anytime-Constrained Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2311-05511.creator: Jeremy McMahan, Xiaojin Zhu
arxiv-2311-05511.description: Abstract We introduce and study constrained Markov Decision Processes (cMDPs) with anytime constraints. An anytime constraint requires the agent to never violate its budget at any point in time, almost surely. Although Markovian policies are no longer sufficient, we show that there exist optimal deterministic policies augmented with cumulative costs.

arxiv-2405-16418.title: Unraveling the Smoothness Properties of Diffusion Models: A Gaussian Mixture Perspective
arxiv-2405-16418.creator: Yingyu Liang, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Yufa Zhou
arxiv-2405-16418.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yingyu Liang, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Yufa Zhou. Diffusion models have made rapid progress in generating high-quality samples across various domains. However, a theoretical understanding of the Lipschitz continuity and second momentum properties of the diffusion process is still lacking. In this paper, we bridge this gap by providing a detailed examination of these smoothness properties for the case where the target data distribution is a mixture of Gaussians, which serves as a universal approximator for smooth densities such as image data.

arxiv-2505-21048.title: Entanglement negativity of general 2 × ( 2 ​ n + 1 ) 2\times(2n+1) qubit-qudit system
arxiv-2505-21048.creator: Sanskriti Agrawal, Raktim Abir
arxiv-2505-21048.description: Abstract The presence of negative eigenvalue(s) in the spectrum of the partially transposed density matrix confirms the entanglement of the quantum state. The negative eigenvalue(s) also quantify the amount of entanglement through novel entanglement measures, e . g . e.g. , negativity.

arxiv-2506-18087.title: Federated Learning-Based Data Collaboration Method for Enhancing Edge Cloud AI System Security Using Large Language Models
arxiv-2506-18087.creator: Huaiying Luo Cheng Ji College of Computing and Information Science Siebel School of Computing and Data Science Cornell University University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign New York, USA Champaign, Illinois, USA hl2446@cornell.edu chengji5@illinois.edu

With the widespread application of edge computing and cloud systems in AI-driven applications, how to maintain efficient performance while ensuring data privacy has become an urgent security issue.

arxiv-2508-19396.title: The Seven Dwarfs illuminated
arxiv-2508-19396.creator: Bernhard Baumschlager, Sijing Shen, James W. Wadsley, Benjamin Keller, Robert Wissing, Lucio Mayer, Piero Madau, Ferah Munshi, Alyson Brooks
arxiv-2508-19396.description: Abstract We present a high-resolution cosmological zoom-in simulation of a group of field dwarf galaxies which includes on-the-fly radiative transfer (RT) and is evolved to z = 0 z=0 . Emission from stars is included according to age-dependent spectral energy distributions, and a redshift-dependent UV background (UVB) is modelled by background particles and propagated through the simulation volume.

arxiv-2510-19926.title: An accurate measure of the size of dark matter halos using the size of galaxies
arxiv-2510-19926.creator: Claudio Dalla Vecchia ,, Ignacio Trujillo
arxiv-2510-19926.description: Abstract The physically motivated definition of galaxy size proposed recently, linked to the farther location of the in-situ star formation, considerably reduces the scatter of the galaxy mass–size relation, and provide a viable method to infer the galaxy stellar mass from its size.

The Mentored Research Development Award (MRDA), a professional development program embedded in our IDeA-funded center, provides junior investigators with mentorship and effort offset to write a grant.

pmc-10609501.title: Diet and Depression during Peri- and Post-Menopause: A Scoping Review Protocol
pmc-10609501.creator: Alexandra M Bodnaruc, Miryam Duquet, Denis Prud’homme, Isabelle Giroux, Garth Maker
pmc-10609501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The aim of the proposed scoping review is to describe and summarize studies assessing the associations between diet-related variables and depression in peri- and post-menopausal women. Studies examining the associations between diet-related variables and mental health indicators in women undergoing menopausal transition or in the post-menopausal period will be systematically retrieved via Medline, EMBASE, PsycINFO, Web of Science, and Scopus databases. All articles identified through the database searches will be imported into Covidence.

pmc-10650082.creator: Young Woo Kim, Dongwoon Lee, Yongmin Jeon, Hocheon Yoo, Eou-Sik Cho, Ezgi Darici, Young-Jun Park, Kang-Il Seo, Sang-Jik Kwon, Shijian Su
pmc-10650082.description: The vacuum process using small molecule-based organic materials to make organic photodiodes (OPDIs) will provide many promising features, such as well-defined molecular structure, large scalability, process repeatability, and good compatibility for CMOS integration, compared to the widely used Solution process.

pmc-10669460.title: The Upper Limb Orthosis in the Rehabilitation of Stroke Patients: The Role of 3D Printing
pmc-10669460.creator: Andrea Demeco, Ruben Foresti, Antonio Frizziero, Nicola Daracchi, Francesco Renzi, Margherita Rovellini, Antonello Salerno, Chiara Martini, Laura Pelizzari, Cosimo Costantino, Philippe Gorce, Redha Taiar
pmc-10669460.description: Stroke represents the third cause of long-term disability in the world. About 80% of stroke patients have an impairment of bio-motor functions and over half fail to regain arm functionality, resulting in motor movement control disorder with serious loss in terms of social independence.

pmc-11465733.title: Deciphering the complete genome sequence of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli strain Hakim RU_GHWS isolated from ladies' hall sewage water in Bangladesh
pmc-11465733.creator: Md. Arif-Uz-Zaman Polash, Nusrat Zahan, Muhib Ullah Khan, Subir Sarker, Tianyu Zhang, Md. Hakimul Haque
pmc-11465733.description: This report details the genome sequence of Escherichia coli strain Hakim RU_GHWS, isolated from sewage water. The assembled genome comprises 5.022 Mb with 77.675× coverage, depicting an average GC content of 50.50%. This genome contains 10 CRISPR arrays, 14 prophages, 65 antibiotic resistance genes, and 28 virulence factor genes.

pmc-11645702.title: Visualizing drug-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome: a clinical image
pmc-11645702.creator: Shivali Kalode, Prerna Tekulwar
pmc-11645702.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Here, we are presenting a case of a 53-year-old male, who presented in the dermatology department with a chief complaint of fever and extensive rashes over the trunk and bilateral upper limbs for a day. It was also associated with pain which was sudden in onset, burning type, continuous, localized, and severe in intensity, aggravated on touching with no relieving factor.

pmc-12399574.title: Transformer-based multimodal precision intervention model for enhancing diaphragm function in elderly patients
pmc-12399574.creator: Ma Xinli, Zhao Jie, Yan Ming, Zhang Yanping, Li Fan, Jia Jing, Ding Lu
pmc-12399574.description: Diaphragm dysfunction represents a significant complication in elderly patients undergoing mechanical ventilation, often resulting in extended intensive care stays, unsuccessful weaning attempts, and increased healthcare expenditures. To address the deficiency of precise, real-time decision support in this context, a novel artificial intelligence framework is proposed, integrating imaging, physiological signals, and ventilator parameters.

pmc-12575853.title: Kinetically-controlled intermediate-direct-pinning for homogeneous energy landscapes in quasi-two-dimensional perovskites for efficient and narrow blue emission
pmc-12575853.creator: Joo Sung Kim, Hyeon-Dong Lee, Jeong Hyun Jung, Taehee Kim, Seung-Je Woo, Hyung Joong Yoon, Jaehyun Moon, Chan-mo Kang, Seung-Eui Chang, Dong-Hyeok Kim, Sungjin Kim, Hoichang Yang, Dongho Kim, Tae-Woo Lee
pmc-12575853.description: Quasi-two-dimensional perovskite structures hold great potential as active layers in blue perovskite light-emitting diodes. However, they face challenges of limited emission efficiency and broadened spectra due to phase inhomogeneity. Here, we report an intermediate-direct-pinning method to develop a uniform-phase quasi-two-dimensional structure with a homogeneous energy landscape.

pmc-12614611.title: Privacy-preserving AUC computation in distributed machine learning with PHT-meDIC
pmc-12614611.creator: Marius de Arruda Botelho, Cem Ata Baykara, Ali Burak Ünal, Nico Pfeifer, Mete Akgün
pmc-12614611.description: Ensuring privacy in distributed machine learning while computing the Area Under the Curve (AUC) is a significant challenge because pooling sensitive test data is often not allowed. Although cryptographic methods can address some of these concerns, they may compromise either scalability or accuracy.

pmc-12933583.title: Efficacy of double half-pigtail plastic stents for endoscopic biliary drainage of acute calculous cholangitis
pmc-12933583.creator: Toshitaka Sakai, Yoshihide Kanno, Shinsuke Koshita, Takahisa Ogawa, Hiroaki Kusunose, Keisuke Yonamine, Kazuaki Miyamoto, Fumisato Kozakai, Haruka Okano, Kento Hosokawa, Hidehito Sumiya, Jun Horaguchi, Masaya Oikawa, Takashi Tsuchiya, Yutaka Noda, Kei Ito
pmc-12933583.description: Background/Aims:Plastic stent placement is required when biliary stones cannot be completely removed during the initial endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP). Although double half-pigtail plastic stents (DHPs) help prevent stent migration, their clinical utility has not yet been evaluated.Methods:We retrospectively reviewed data from 221 patients who underwent DHP placement for acute calculous cholangitis (ACC) between January 2015 and March 2024.

pmc-13348375.title: Novel Application of the AGN1 Triphasic Calcium-Based Implant for a Large Simple Bone Cyst in a Child With 3-Year Follow-up: A Case Report
pmc-13348375.creator: Nicolas De Ridder, Charlotte Draelants, Jo De Schepper
pmc-13348375.description: Introduction:Simple bone cysts (SBCs) are benign lesions in children, typically in the proximal humerus. While many are asymptomatic, some necessitate treatment because of impending pathological fractures. Different treatment modalities exist, but no consensus on the best method has been established.

pmc-13375429.title: Differentiating Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis From Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Children: A Multidisciplinary Diagnostic Approach, Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13375429.creator: Heba M. Reyad, Narmen Eltrafi, Walaa H. Ali, Mohamed Abdelrazek, Marwa Khairy Abd Elwahab, Eiman Ibrahim, Seham Nabil Ramdan, Ahmed Akef, Jumana Ahmed Eid, Mohamed Hashem Youssef Abdou, Soad A. Eltokhy, Sedeek Mosaid, Mona E. Hashem, Iman Ahmed Kassem, Ramy Saleh Abdelghany
pmc-13375429.description: BackgroundJuvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) share overlapping musculoskeletal presentations in pediatric patients, and the misclassification of ALL as JIA carries life-threatening consequences due to inappropriate initiation of corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy. A rigorous synthesis of contemporary evidence identifying the most reliable clinical and laboratory discriminators between these two conditions is long overdue.

pmc-13403951.title: Mental Fatigue in Collegiate Athletes: A Behavioral Science Review of Stress Appraisal, Competitive Anxiety, and Resilience-Related Regulation
pmc-13403951.creator: Zihan Gao, Wan Ahmad Munsif Wan Pa, Mohamad Nizam bin Nazarudin
pmc-13403951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mental fatigue is an increasingly important concern among collegiate athletes whose academic–athletic roles require sustained cognitive effort, emotional regulation, and recovery across overlapping performance contexts. This structured narrative review synthesizes behavioral science, sport psychology, and athlete mental health literature to clarify how perceived stress, competitive anxiety, and psychological resilience may interact in the development and regulation of mental fatigue among collegiate athletes.

pmc-13446732.title: Feasibility, safety, and preliminary clinical efficacy of resting-state functional connectivity MRI-guided rTMS for adolescents with major depressive disorder: Protocol for a randomized, double-blind, three-arm, sham-controlled pilot trial
pmc-13446732.creator: Hongyi Chen, Danyu Xu, Wenjing Wang, Xinyin Luo, Xiaocong Jiang, Ningyi Wan, Yuhuan Wei, Ting Wang, Li Zhang, Xuemei Li, Xinyu Zhou
pmc-13446732.description: BackgroundMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is highly prevalent in adolescents, and a substantial proportion of patients show inadequate response or limited tolerability to first-line treatments such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors and cognitive behavioral therapy, highlighting the need for additional treatment options. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has demonstrated efficacy in adults with depression, but evidence in adolescents remains limited.
